title: A rapid, metal-free synthesis of amino- and hydroxyphenanthrenes with tunable photophysical properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38024-38028
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06485F, Paper
Open Access

Here we report a general, metal-free strategy for the regioselective synthesis of amino- and hydroxyphenanthrenes from 1- and 2-naphthaldehydes.
